items.DR_Death_Veil.name: Death's Veil
items.DR_Death_Veil.description:
Beneath this ragged midnight cowl, a pale mask keeps its final vigil. Its hollow gaze recalls the Horseman who walked beyond the grave and returned with the silence of kingdoms.

+18 Health, +30 Mana. Physical/Projectile resistance: 9%; Void resistance: 8%.
Primary Necromancer affinity: +5% Sorcery, +3 Flow. Advanced Necromancer paths qualify. Bonuses require this piece to be equipped and unbroken.
items.DR_Reaper_Mantle.name: Mantle of the Reaper
items.DR_Reaper_Mantle.description:
A cage of ancient ribs rises into the broken wings of a deathless reaper. Verdigris iron and funerary bronze bind its spectral heart; the living hear a heartbeat where no heart remains.

+36 Health, +25 Mana. Physical/Projectile resistance: 16%; Void resistance: 12%.
Primary Necromancer affinity: +4% Sorcery, +4 Life Force. Advanced Necromancer paths qualify. Bonuses require this piece to be equipped and unbroken.
items.DR_Harvester_Grasp.name: Harvester's Grasp
items.DR_Harvester_Grasp.description:
These burial-bound gauntlets close with the certainty of a final breath. Bone knuckles cradle the haft of the Harbinger, lending flesh and sorcery to the work of the Pale Rider.

+16 Health, +15 Mana. Physical/Projectile resistance: 7%; Void resistance: 4%.
Primary Necromancer affinity: +4% Strength, +4% Sorcery. Advanced Necromancer paths qualify. Bonuses require this piece to be equipped and unbroken.
items.DR_Pale_Rider_Strides.name: Pale Rider's Strides
items.DR_Pale_Rider_Strides.description:
Tattered funeral cloth trails behind greaves that have crossed the Dead Kingdom without leaving a footprint. Every measured step carries their wearer closer to the next soul's appointed hour.

+26 Health, +3 Stamina. Physical/Projectile resistance: 13%; Void resistance: 6%.
Primary Necromancer affinity: +3 Flow, +3% Haste. Advanced Necromancer paths qualify. Bonuses require this piece to be equipped and unbroken.
